how to choose payment mode for patient

To choose the payment mode for a patient, select the payment category and allocate the cash/credit scheme to the patient. Payments can be made using either cash or card, with the option to select either a credit or debit card. For allocating credit facility to a patient, click on F7, and for allocating cash facility, click on F9.
